newsitem.title: CAYMAN ISLANDS: Cayman Islands stock exchange opens.
newsitem.headline: Cayman Islands stock exchange opens.

text.p: The Cayman Islands Stock Exchange officially opened for business on Thursday, but actual trading is not expected to begin until later in the first quarter of 1997, officials said.

David Carrad, acting director of the exchange, said it is taking applications from listing agents through Jan. 17. Following that, the exchange will take applications for the actual mutual funds to be traded.
Trading on the new exchange should begin by the end of March, he said. "Sometime in the first quarter is our target date," he said.
Carrad said the Cayman exchange would initially trade only mutual funds, but would eventually add corporate stocks, Eurobonds and other securities.
